items.description: China's Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical radio Telescope, or FAST, the world's most sensitive single-dish radio telescope, has discovered a binary neutron star system with an extremely short orbital period and the lowest total mass ever recorded, providing a new laboratory for studying matter under extreme conditions, testing theories of gravity and exploring the origins of heavy elements in the universe.
